## About
Price Rite Tire & Auto Center is a tire shop in Phoenix. We specialize in new and used tires, and our friendly staff is here to help you find what fits your vehicle and your budget.
You can search our tire listings online by size or item number, filter by new or used, and choose singles, pairs or full sets. If you have a question, call us or send a note through the contact form.
You can also pick up a U-Haul at this location. We hold a 4 star Google rating from 100 reviews.

## Services
- Used tires: Good used tires from our stock, listed online so you can check sizes and prices ahead of time.
- New tires: New tires for your car or truck. Ask our staff to help you find the right fit.
- U-Haul: Pick up a U-Haul at our shop. One reviewer said it was very easy and convenient.

## FAQ
Q: Can I buy a single tire, or do I need a full set?
A: Either works. Our online listings let you filter for singles, pairs or sets.

Q: What are your hours on Saturday?
A: On Saturday we are open from 8 AM to noon.

Q: How can I ask about a tire before coming in?
A: Call the shop or fill out the contact form on our website and we will get back to you.
